How to make a location QR code

You can use either a Google Maps link or plain coordinates. A Maps link is usually easier and shows your business name and photos.

  1. Open Google Maps on your phone or computer and search for your shop, office or venue.
  2. Tap Share and copy the link. Or long-press the exact spot on the map to drop a pin and copy the coordinates shown at the top.
  3. Paste the link or coordinates into the field above.
  4. Choose colors, add a logo if you like, and download the PNG or SVG.
  5. Scan it with your phone to check it opens the correct pin, not just the general area.

Maps link or coordinates?

Both open a map on the scanner's phone. They behave a little differently.

Tips for a location QR code that guides people correctly

A code that drops people at the wrong gate is worse than no code.

  • Drop the pin at the entrance, not the middle of the building or a nearby landmark.
  • Test on foot or by car and see what the navigation app suggests from a distance.
  • Use a full Maps link rather than a shortened one if you can. It is easier to check before printing.
  • Add a line of text like "Scan for directions" and your landmark or address as a backup.
  • Make it large enough for the distance. Codes on a board scanned from a few feet away should be much larger than a card code.
